description: Gigs HAPPENING across the UK — the public listings directory of shows to go and see (mostly imported, already booked). This is NOT a list of work to apply for: if a member asks what they can apply for / pitch for / play, use search_open_gigs instead. Filter by city and/or a date range ("this weekend"). Paginated.

city.description: UK city/town to filter by. Omit for national.

date_from.description: Earliest gig date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

window_days.description: How many days ahead to include (default 180). Ignored when date_from/date_to are given.

name: search_gigs
title: Search live music gigs
